description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and convert BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and the Hibernate/JPA dialect for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax, including changing photo BLOB columns to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure the application to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
